reviews.text:
I was able to get an appointment for my furry baby right away. The staff at the front was very courteous and thoughtful. We were taken into sn exam room almost immediately. The vet tech came in and was very friendly and also very thorough in her questions.
The vet was excellent too! She was very easy to talk to, she was very clear in her explanations, she sensed my dog’s nervousness so she got down on the floor to examine him. The next day she called me and spent a long time on the phone explaining his test results and addressing our concerns.
We have been going to Dixie for over 20 years and in our opinion they are the best veterinary team in Miami!
Highly recommend them.

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, personalized care to every pet and their family, and it means so much to know that you felt well cared for. We look forward to seeing you and your furry family member again! 🐾❤️
Thank you for your kind rating; we appreciate your valuable feedback!
These vets are the best! Always caring and gentle. Love the staff as well.

We had a wonderful experience in Dixie animal hospital ,Sofi our golden retriever had the spay surgery performed by Dr Smiely and Dr Gaviria .
They are so professional and in general all their staff are really good  , they answered all our questions and help us so much to know that everything would be OK with Sofi ( our baby) .
Definitely Sofi  couldn’t be in better hands .
We loved the idea of those phone calls after the surgery ,  to ask about how was Sofi doing, they really care about patients.
We really appreciate all the staff of Dixie animal hospital  , we highly recommend   it.
Thank you very much .

My experience with Dixie Animal Hospital has been wonderful. I have two standard poodles, and they are a great help with my dogs. The customer service is excellent, from the front desk staff to the outstanding vets. I strongly recommend them.

I took my puppy Pebble to Dixie and they were excellent with him. The staff at the front were very kind and welcoming, and immediately made Pebble feel at ease. The vets, vet techs, and everyone here clearly loves animals. Great place to take your pet!!!
Love this hospital. Everyone is so friendly, helpful and you can tell they really care for the animals.

This clinic is a very professional center. Each attendant show kindness and affection for out pets. they give thorough explanation of the examinations. Not only that, but when necessary to put a pet down, the doctor and attendants show great compassion and empathy during the process. I highly recommend this hospital / clinic.

Excellent care for my 10 year old golden doodle.
Compassionate care when we needed to board our 17 year old Maltese.
Dr. Pegalow , the vet techs, and staff  have all shown me immeasurable kindness, as our babies were in their care when we had an unexpected and tragic loss in our family, exactly one year ago today!
Tremendous care, attention , support and guidance for abandoned female nursing  cat  and  kittens. Working together to vaccinate, spay, neuter, socialize and become adoptable in the best possible way, physically and emotionally.
They’ve always shown quality care to our personal dogs and cats, extremely helpful with my revolving door of rescues, quiet room and respect when I’ve insisted on holding  my very ill dog (s) and 19 year old cat , gently sedating to sleep in my arms as we eased their pain and let them be free.
In an effort to stop the over population of kittens, homeless animals , and over crowed shelters , I appreciate I have had all hands on board when hoping for ending with Happy Tails!
Wendy B.
Palmetto Bay
I have been coming to Dixie Animal Hospital for over 60 years. Great staff great Doctors and care.
Outstanding service, very happy with the way they treated my 2 dogs.
Thank you so much for your 5 star review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to leave a review. We’re glad you had a great experience and look forward to welcoming you again soon.
Excellent service, I'll remember them for pet care. 🤩😍 …

Dr. Smiley was so kind and efficient. With two babies, I needed to be in and out, and that’s exactly how the visit went. I lean more toward homeopathic approaches, and she followed up by emailing me a thoughtful list of alternative options.

Dixie Animal Hospital is truly exceptional!

Our Standard Poodle recently fractured a molar and needed to have it removed. She was also due for a dental cleaning and her yearly checkup, so we scheduled everything together. Naturally, we were nervous about how our Lucy would handle the anesthesia, extraction, and other procedures.

Dr. Pegelow took the time to thoroughly explain every step of the process and what to expect during her recovery. We were even provided with before-and-after photos of her teeth and the fractured molar, which was incredibly reassuring. The follow-up calls we received afterward showed just how much they care.

The clinic is clean, welcoming, and staffed by knowledgeable professionals who clearly love their patients. A heartfelt thank-you to Dr. Pegelow, Dr. Smiley, Dr. Gaviria and the entire team—Chelsea, Antinique, and Jules.

You are all amazing!

Excellent experience with Dr. Pegelow.  I took my 13 yr old terrier mix there for 3 years.  They are located a bit far from me and I can no longer drive due to vision loss, and my dog now needs specialized care due to cancer surgery and incision complications, so she goes to a more specialized place closer by.  But I am grateful for the time she was able to spend with Dr. Pegelow at Dixie.  He is very caring and involved.

Dixie Animal Hospital provided a phenomenal experience from beginning to end. I initially came in skeptical and concerned about the quality of care my 13-year-old cat would receive, as my past experiences with other veterinary offices were disappointing—rushed exams, minimal evaluations, and generic answers that led to no real solutions.

However, my experience at Dixie Animal Hospital was completely different—truly a well-deserved story to share. Dr. Jane Smiley was exceptional. She was thorough, attentive, and took the time to explain every detail regarding my cat’s health. Dr. Smiley’s communication was clear and educational, helping me understand my cat’s condition and the available treatment options.

What stood out most was Dr. Smiley’s transparency and genuine care. She personally followed up multiple times to discuss updates, next steps, and even helped find cost-effective options for medications. Her dedication and compassion made the entire process feel safe and comforting—for both me and my cat.

I’m beyond grateful to have found Dixie Animal Hospital. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking compassionate, knowledgeable, and trustworthy veterinary care.
If you want excellent service, you can get it from Isabella. Charismatic, efficient, and kind, she is the true meaning of someone who loves their work...

Took our pet cat Harry for a life quality review . He was very very thin with a terrible gum infection. I thought he also had cancer and was expecting to be putting him down. Dr Gaviria examined him and gave me some options before taking that drastic step to see if he would recuperate. With a strong dose of antibiotics and steroids to lower inflamation in injection form, Harry is recuperating amazingly well and eating three cans of soft food a day. He is doing so much better and seems to be recuperating well

We have been taking our pets to Dixie Animal Hospital for over 20 years.   They are the best!  The staff is great, they follow up after every visit, the doctors are experienced and they always show how much they care.

Dixie Animal Hospital is fantastic. We have been going there for over 17 years, and are always extremely satisfied. This week we had an emergency with our dog. Dr. Chavarry could not have been more comprehensive in her evaluation, and was extremely compassionate with our dog and with us. This hospital is wonderful.

I have been bringing my dogs to Dixie animal hospital for about 11 years, and the staff is very responsive to their needs concerning their health with the professionalism you expect from people who love what they do.
Thank you for your kind rating. We appreciate the feedback!
Our yorkie, "Halle",  always has a great experiance with Dr. Smiley and her crew. The follow-up as well is much apprecaited.
Dr Smiley and her staff are the best.
Thank you for the wonderful rating. If you have time to update, we'd love to hear what transpired in your experience to earn 5 stars. Thank you!
I can tell they really care about my dog and that means everything.
Dr. Smiley and her staff are top notch. I am very happy with the care my older cat receives. The office is very clean and the front desk staff is very friendly.

My dogs have been patients of South Dixie Animal Hospital for years.  The first one under the care of Dr. Rainey,  who lived to be 17 years old and the second with Pegalow.  Sad to say that the office stopped being what it was.  Three times now, during normal office hours, they have said they could not see my miniature Dachshund during an emergency.  That is the same as if your toddler with high fever could not be seen by his pediatrician.  So, what is the point of having a Dr?

Sad that after the AMAZING Dr. Rainey we have to leave the office.  Pegalow (the tooth puller as he was known when he interned with Dr. Rainey) should realize the mentors he had.  They would NEVER turn off a patient.

We boarded our 14 year old girl as we had before, trusting that since she was being boarded at the vet’s office, if she got sick during her stay, (although we dropped her off perfectly healthy) they would notice, contact us and treat her. While on vacation, I called every other day to find out if she was well. I was told she was doing well. The morning my husband picked her up, she seemed sick. When he brought her  home, I noticed she was dripping water from her mouth, she was making sounds in her belly and her throat as if she had too much water in her system. I called for an appointment. We took her back to Dixie and we were told she had pneumonia. They gave her meds and recommended we take her to the 24 hour emergency place named Thrive Miami. That night, we took her to Thrive Miami. I still remember her walking in with the person who took her to the back. She was dead within 24 hours. You judge for yourself if you would take your furry family member to Dixie. We were devastated as we had to put her to sleep. It’s been four months and now is when I can bring myself to write this, without crying. No one noticed she was sick at Dixie until we noticed. It was a horrible experience. She was our precious girl, we loved her so much.
Thank you for your kind review. We appreciate any feedback you may have to provide about your visits with us.
First-class service with wonderful doctors and assistants, my dogs are delighted and it will always be my favorite place, thank you!
We have been using Dixie Animal Hospital for over 25 years and continue to find them a most caring place for our pets and for our concerns.
Thank you for the generous rating! We would love to hear what warranted this score and also what we can improve to give you a 5 star experience in the future.

I’ve been taking my girls here since one was 3 months and the other was about 5 months. We moved further from here but continue to come. Our expectations are always exceeded and we trust our girls are in good hands. The front desk team is …
terrible
thank you for this kind rating. We appreciate any feedback you can give us.

Our Kai Kai has been going to Dixie Animal Hospital since he was 12 weeks old.  He is now a 5yr healthy pup.  DAH is simply awesome (pricey but worth every penny). Their customer service - thank you front desk, you are best in class.  They …
